title: An Artist Adrift
description: The famous artist from Fontaine, Julien, remains in Sumeru...

mainQuestExcel.title: An Artist Adrift
mainQuestExcel.description: The famous artist from Fontaine, Julien, remains in Sumeru...

dialogs.text: One of the good things about leaving the city is not having to specially prepare dog food. Pepper's very capable, in any case, and can procure its own meals.
The bad thing, though, is that I lack any talent for combat or cooking. I suppose "city trash" is a fitting name for one such as myself...
I should just focus on recovering.
(Looks at you expectantly.)

flow.stepDescription: Go to the camp by the water

dialogs.text: #Paimon, {NICKNAME}, you're here! Ah, indeed, one needs friends when on a journey outdoors.
Well, we did agree to show you the way, didn't we? Guiding people around is a walk in the park for us! Even though we'll be walking in a desert...
But are you sure you want to go back to Fontaine so soon? You made it all the way to Sumeru, after all. There's still so much to see here!
The rainforest has some nice views.
There's lots of trees and rivers!
They all sound really nice, but I feel that... I haven't made proper preparations for travel. This trip might've been a failure, but I suppose I did learn a lesson or two...
Oh, um... In that case, there's also great stuff to see nearby! It would be a pity if you missed them all.
Paimon's recommendations are never wrong.
If you insist... I guess it would be rude if I were to refuse.
Hehe, Paimon's Teyvat's number one guide, so leave the guiding to Paimon! Just remember to keep up.
The desert has some fascinating sights.
Sand and ruins as far as your eyes can see!
This place is filled with nature's scent! Doesn't it just make you feel like sketching? Doesn't it make you feel inspired?
Now that's a stereotype.
Um... But it does make Paimon wanna pick up a brush! This place is so full of vitality, and the colors are so vivid...
Ahem.
Oh...
Paimon's sorry... Paimon didn't mean to...
Haha, it's fine. I just see something different, that's all. We can all appreciate beauty, right?
That's right! Paimon loves this place. It's almost as if it can purify your heart and soul.
Not that you need it, Paimon.
My friends, thank you for showing me such kindness — even to someone like me, who has failed to tell you the truth from the beginning.
You are both indeed pure of heart.
Hehe... No need to exaggerate so much. Oh, and there are actually more unique sights than this!
#Paimon's sure you know what she's referring to, {NICKNAME}. Let's show it to Julien as well!
They say that artists will observe their subject from many angles before they start. Is that some sort of... "stereotype"?
We could have a look around first, and if that fails, we can find a vantage point with a better view!
That sounds like a good idea. I'm ready to set out.
#Hehe, shall we race to the destination? Are you ready, {NICKNAME}?
Let's go!
Let's go!
Let's make some preparations first.
Alright then. Let's go once we're ready!

flow.stepDescription: Go to a vantage point with a better view

dialogs.text: Phew... I didn't think that drawing was such a taxing thing to do. If I had known that, I would've...
Looks like that was still a bit much for Julien...
Well, I did just... recover from my injuries... *pants*
But the sights here are truly unique. Indeed, I think it's strange that I never noticed them before...
The view's pretty good up ahead as well. Let's head over there — but be careful, okay?

flow.stepDescription: Leave the vantage point and keep moving

dialogs.text: How's that? Pretty nice, eh? Pepper also seemed really happy.
Having seen this, I find that words seem superfluous. Caterpillar was right. There is such a wide world outside my metal box...
A metal box... You said that you lived in a very small place in Fontaine, didn't you?
Ahem. Sumeru sure does have lots of sights to see, huh?
Ah, right, that's right! He's already decided to be a proper artist, so let's switch up the scene a bit to... what do they call it... broaden our horizons!
He might have said that he wants to give up, but Paimon thinks it's still too early for that! There's still time to reconsider...
Just think about it, Julien! There might be sights just as grand as this, or maybe even grander — things you've never seen before! Maybe they'll grant you the inspiration you need!
As for your color recognition, well, you said it yourself! We just "see something different"...
But we can all appreciate beauty.
Yeah!
Yes... Your words do make sense.
Those were your words!
I... Haha, so I knew it. I knew it after all, but I just kept walking the wrong path...
We only met because Pepper brought you here, right? So we shouldn't just think of it as the "wrong path"!
Well, it's a shame that we couldn't help you find the path of the Oceanids' pilgrimage, though...
Does that even exist...
I've always believed it does, but... I think that my ability or lack thereof to find it is unimportant either way.
After all, I've already found the answer I desire.
Thank you, my friends. *sigh* How can I ever show my gratitude?
If only I had bought those mysterious bird eggs... A mystical item like that, one that can help to ward off ill fortune, would certainly be of more use to adventurers like you.
That does seem like a bit of a pity.
#Wait, do you really believe in something that convenient, {NICKNAME}?
I will continue to stay here for a while. This place really calms the soul. It's quite good for self-reflection.
I have a feeling that I might be able to draw something a little different this time...
Thank you both, dear friends. I wish you smooth sailing in your journey!
It's fine, but I don't think it's necessary.
Why not? Even if it can't really deflect bad luck, maybe... maybe it might taste a hundred times better than a normal egg!

questNarration.text: Julien cannot keep up. Perhaps you may find him back at the start.
